strengths: Coherent synthwave/outrun look: a neon magenta grid floor, a glowing horizon sun, wireframe mountains and a dark navy board with pink rim edges
Bloom is used well on the snake head, the food beacon and the neon edges, which gives a polished glowing look

There are several 3D depth cues: the board sits as a raised slab with beveled edges, the camera looks along it in perspective, floating rings and diamonds hang in the sky and pink spotlight beams come off the corners
The food is a tall golden light beam, so you can spot it from anywhere on the board, and eating it sends out an expanding golden ring
Title and game-over cards are styled to match, with a gradient title, a 'NEW BEST' badge and a clean SCORE/BEST/LEVEL HUD
Stable: 13/13 checks passed, no page errors and the autopilot ate 22 foods in 40 s
weaknesses: The low camera squashes the far rows, and the snake and food sit there in most frames, so they look tiny and hard to read
The snake is plain glowing spheres; at this distance there is no visible shaping or detail
The sky is crowded with floating rings and diamonds and the backdrop is very bright, which competes with the actual play area
The eating effect is subtle: one thin ring, with no visible particles or score popup
On a phone in portrait the board is small and the title card covers the lower part of the scene, leaving large empty grid areas
The HUD labels are very small and faint
oneLine: A stable, cohesive synthwave Snake with good bloom and real depth that looks like a finished game, but the low camera keeps the snake and food small and hard to read at the far end of a busy scene.
